user.title: Onboard ESPHome Device to Latter
user.description: Screen geometry, resolution (466x466 vs 410x502), and BLE capabilities are auto-detected from your device hardware. Shared household settings (Remotes, Volume Routing, Weather, Alarm, Calendars) are inherited automatically and managed in the Latter sidebar panel.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Latter Device
reconfigure.description: Update the primary room, default speaker, or apply a saved configuration profile. Open the Latter sidebar panel for full System & Device Studio controls.

abort.already_configured: This ESPHome device is already configured in Latter.
abort.not_supported: This ESPHome device does not announce Latter companion contract actions or metadata.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The ESPHome device slug does not match the existing configuration entry.

init.title: Latter Device Options
init.description: Update the starting room, default speaker, or apply a saved profile. For full System & Device configuration, open the Latter panel in your Home Assistant sidebar.

confirm.title: Update mapped entity in Latter
confirm.description: The following mapped entity for `{device_slug}` was deleted or renamed in Home Assistant: **{missing_list}**. Open the Latter Companion Studio or integration options to select a replacement.

ble_no_proxies.title: No room-assigned BLE proxies found for {device_slug}

confirm.title: Assign Bluetooth proxies to Home Assistant Areas
confirm.description: Built-in BLE Room Presence is enabled for `{device_slug}`, but no active Bluetooth scanners/proxies are assigned to a Home Assistant Area. Assign each ESPHome BLE proxy to its room Area in Home Assistant, or disable Built-In BLE Tracking if not used.
